Job Description:


B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, AI/ML, or related field
2 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development or GenAI application building
Demonstrated experience with at least one LLM API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) in a production or POC setting
Strong Python programming skills with experience in AI/ML libraries
Understanding of software engineering principles, version control, and code quality practices
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is preferred
Certifications in AI/ML (Google, AWS, Microsoft, DeepLearning.AI) are a plus

Good to Have

Experience integrating AI with ERP systems such as SAP S/4HANA or CRM platforms like Salesforce
Knowledge of agentic AI frameworks (AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph)
Exposure to computer vision or document intelligence (Azure Form Recognizer, AWS Textract)
Understanding of cybersecurity principles in AI systems
Experience in e-commerce, B2B/B2C platforms, or supply chain domains
